readme: Alert thresholds — the ONE place the Alert Center's rules are tuned. Hosted at tla-core/docs/curated/alert-thresholds.json; the member-data cron (hourly) reads it, evaluates the TLA rules against the daily products and writes member-data/tla-alerts/current.json (fired rows + how often each rule fired at 0.5× / 1× / 2× of its thresholds). The site's Alert Center reads that product and shows this config in its ⚙ Thresholds tab, where you can adjust values and download a new copy of this file to upload here. Calibrated 2026-09-17 on 127 days of history: per-pool VP moves are routine noise (90th percentile 37% in a day) so pool_vp_move is OFF; bucket VP is quiet (95th percentile 2.4%) so a 3% within-epoch move is a real signal. Calibration replay (127 days, gate mock-run-tla-alerts.js): gauge_set_change 3.4/month · epoch_flip 4.4 · bucket_vp_move 3.7 · pool_liquidity_move 1.7 · pool_volume_spike and pool_apr_move tuned to stay under ~6/month.

gauge_set_change.description: A gauge joins or leaves the TLA list, or crosses the vote threshold (starts / stops earning TLA emissions). Only gauges carrying at least min_vp votes — dust gauges flip daily and mean nothing.

epoch_flip.description: One card per epoch rollover (Monday 00:00 UTC): total VP locked, and each bucket's VP against the day before — the moment votes settle and rewards distribute.

bucket_vp_move.description: A bucket's total VP moved inside an epoch (boundary days excluded).

pool_vp_move.description: A single pool's VP moved inside an epoch. OFF by default — the history says this is routine vote shuffling.

pool_liquidity_move.description: Staked liquidity in a TLA pool changed in a day (both directions).

pool_volume_spike.description: A pool's 24h DEX volume against its own trailing median.

pool_apr_move.description: A gauge's Eris APR moved in a day (points AND relative). Epoch-boundary days are skipped — APR resets with the pots every Monday; the epoch_flip card carries that.

live_activity.readme: Live Activity (index.html + the tenant home): how loud each episode is and which listings the DEAL FILTER hides. The episodes themselves come from nft-collections/<collection>/ledger/activity.json (org-nft-flows 1.6.0, facts only); lib/live-activity.js reads these numbers. Edit here, upload to tla-core/docs/curated/alert-thresholds.json.

deal_filter.note: a listing (or a price change) priced more than this % over its class floor on the day is hidden by default — 25% on the tenant you are viewing, 10% on the other collections; Show all reveals them. Classes: aDAO base / broken / Phoenix, Pixel Lions base / Rank 1, from floor-history per_tier. A class with no floor hides nothing. Listings UNDER their class floor are featured.

live_activity.notes: lock_new_big_vp / lock_unlock_big_vp: a new lock / unlock at or above this VP is featured; lock_add_big_usd: a top-up is featured when what was ADDED is at or above this USD (not by the size of the lock it landed in); lock_new_min_vp: a new lock under this VP is a dust lock → housekeeping (hidden with the chip off); mass_count: this many tokens in one folded act is featured; big_sale_usd: a sale at or above this USD (at the time) is featured; fold_ids_shown: ids shown before '+N more'. Always featured: a wallet's first TLA lock, a listed or sold lock, Enterprise unstakes, DAODAO stakes, breaks, mints, under-floor listings. Always housekeeping (chip off by default; a featured row shows anyway): lock merge / split / migrate / auto-max, small top-ups, dust locks. Never in the feed: the DAO's routine backing deposits (backing_add).
